mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_record (session_id, user_id, question_id, user_answer, is_correct, score, max_score, grading_status, graded_by, graded_at, duration_ms, answered_at) VALUES (#{r.sessionId}, #{r.userId}, #{r.questionId}, #{r.userAnswer}, #{r.isCorrect}, #{r.score}, #{r.maxScore}, #{r.gradingStatus}, #{r.gradedBy}, #{r.gradedAt}, #{r.durationMs}, NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_answer = new.user_answer, is_correct = new.is_correct, score = new.score, max_score = new.max_score, grading_status = new.grading_status, graded_by = new.graded_by, graded_at = new.graded_at, duration_ms = new.duration_ms, answered_at = NOW()
